subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested by this issue?
rationale: The requested UI needs public gateway/session semantics beyond current status and hasActiveRun, while related API and UI candidates are still open and not aligned on the durable contract.

options.title: Make the activity API canonical first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to settle the backend activity, attention, child-rollup, and reconnect semantics before landing the compact UI strip.

options.title: Narrow an open PR into the landing path
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96672 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92697 as a candidate only after maintainers trim it to the accepted contract and proof requirements.

options.title: Defer the compact strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse composer status until maintainers are ready to own a structured session activity contract.

recommendation.title: Make the activity API canonical first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to settle the backend activity, attention, child-rollup, and reconnect semantics before landing the compact UI strip.

likelyOwner.reason: This is both a Control UI UX decision and a gateway/session contract decision; steipete has recent history in the checked-out chat composer path and broad gateway-adjacent maintainer work.
